svg.title: Twelve ridges, one for each layer of GPT-2 small, moving between random init, where all sit at zero, and the trained model, where all but L1 sit left of the dip.
svg.text: Every layer but L1 slides past the dip together
A sketch in depth: one normal curve for each layer, with its median h and its median neuron's SD.
Only the two end states are measured. The dark line on the floor is GELU's dip, at −0.75.
